name: Handle Changed or New QBO Payment ( {QBO Payment} )
purpose: Applies a QuickBooks Online payment to Karbon: validates the JSON parameter, converts it with "Convert QBO Payment into Karbon Payment" and creates or updates the Karbon payment with "Create or Update Payment { Payment }", returning that script's result.
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/403 "Convert QBO Payment into Karbon Payment" (step 30)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/404 "Create or Update Payment { Payment }" (step 33)
open_question: All writes happen in karbon_kontroller scripts 403 (conversion) and 404 (create/update), outside this share. Called from karbon_LedgerLink script 625 "Handle Payment Update" through a data-source reference.
